+                # Compute dot product of unit vectors
+                dot = xi*xj + yi*yj + zi*zj
+                # Clamp dot to [-1, 1] to avoid domain errors
+                dot = max(-1.0, min(1.0, dot))
+                # Chord distance squared:

+                # Vector from i to j

+                vy = yj - yi
+                vz = zj - zi

+                uz = vz_proj / mag_proj
